briefdescription.para: Handles the interrupts for the driver.

detaileddescription.para: It must be connected to an interrupt system by the application such that it can be called when an interrupt occurs.

parameterdescription.para: Interrupt vector number. Libmetal status handler expects two parameters in the handler prototype, hence kept this parameter. This is not used inside the interrupt handler API.
Pointer to the driver instance.

simplesect.para: Vector param is not useful inside the interrupt handler, hence typecast with void to remove compilation warning.

briefdescription.para: Sets the status callback function (the status handler).

detaileddescription.para: The driver calls the status handler when it encounters conditions that should be reported to the higher layer software. The handler executes in an interrupt context, so the amount of processing should be minimized.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XRFdc instance.
Upper layer callback reference passed back when the callback function is invoked.
Pointer to the callback function.

simplesect.para: The handler is called within interrupt context, so it should finish its work quickly.
